corporator.en: Thank you for your note. Ward B has 5 crews and a flood-prone index of 0.55, so rain work is stretched. We have spent ₹35.1 lakh of ₹43 lakh and are checking ₹7.2 lakh of payments. 10 complaints are open. I will have RD0016 P D'Mello Road patched and update you next week.

corporator.qc2Reason: 'Recovering ₹7.2 lakh of excess payments' tells a corporator that contractors were overpaid as settled fact; the flags are unverified and mostly from heavy rain weeks. Other wards say 'checking'.

morning.en:
• Money: spent ₹67.6 lakh of ₹84 lakh. Flagged as possibly payable by others: ₹17.3 lakh. Check, then recover.
• Complaints: 61 open of 335. Start with BMC25-000726, open since 18 June.
• Top road: RD0104 Gokhale Road. Mastic asphalt, about ₹31,042.
morning.mr:
• पैसे: ₹84 लाखांपैकी ₹67.6 लाख खर्च. दुसऱ्यांनी भरायला हवे होते असे संभाव्य म्हणून चिन्हांकित: ₹17.3 लाख. आधी तपासा, मग वसूल करा.
• तक्रारी: 335 पैकी 61 उघड्या. BMC25-000726 पासून सुरुवात करा, 18 जूनपासून उघडी.
• मुख्य रस्ता: RD0104 Gokhale Road. मास्टिक डांबर, सुमारे ₹31,042.
morning.qc2Reason: Marathi 'न द्यायला हवे असलेले' means 'should not have been paid' (a wrongful payment), not 'payable by someone else'.

corporator.en: Thank you for your message. This ward has 9 crews and a flood index of 0.8, so many sites are low-lying. 61 of 335 complaints are open. I will review the oldest ones and share a repair plan for RD0104 Gokhale Road with you this week.
corporator.mr: आपल्या संदेशाबद्दल धन्यवाद. या वॉर्डमध्ये 9 क्रू आहेत आणि पूर निर्देशांक 0.8 आहे, म्हणजे अनेक जागा सखल आहेत. 335 पैकी 61 तक्रारी उघड्या आहेत. मी सर्वात जुन्या तक्रारी तपासेन आणि RD0104 Gokhale Road च्या दुरुस्तीचा आराखडा या आठवड्यात आपल्याला देईन.

morning.en:
• Money: spent ₹61.5 lakh of ₹82 lakh. Flagged as possibly payable by others: ₹13.9 lakh. Check each flag.
• Complaints: 42 open of 285. Start with BMC25-000010, open since 1 June.
• Top road: RD0108 Western Express Highway. Mastic asphalt, about ₹23,062.
morning.mr:
• पैसे: ₹82 लाखांपैकी ₹61.5 लाख खर्च. दुसऱ्यांनी भरायला हवे होते असे संभाव्य म्हणून चिन्हांकित: ₹13.9 लाख. प्रत्येक नोंद तपासा.
• तक्रारी: 285 पैकी 42 उघड्या. BMC25-000010 पासून सुरुवात करा, 1 जूनपासून उघडी.
• मुख्य रस्ता: RD0108 Western Express Highway. मास्टिक डांबर, सुमारे ₹23,062.
morning.qc2Reason: Marathi 'न द्यायला हवे असलेले' means a wrongful payment. 'Ask contractors to recheck' points at contractors before the flags are checked.

corporator.en: Thank you for writing. The ward has 10 crews and a flood index of 0.75. 42 of 285 complaints are open. I will check the oldest open complaint, BMC25-000010, and update you on RD0108 Western Express Highway this week.
corporator.mr: पत्राबद्दल धन्यवाद. वॉर्डमध्ये 10 क्रू आहेत आणि पूर निर्देशांक 0.75 आहे. 285 पैकी 42 तक्रारी उघड्या आहेत. मी सर्वात जुनी उघडी तक्रार BMC25-000010 तपासेन आणि RD0108 Western Express Highway बद्दल या आठवड्यात आपल्याला कळवेन.

morning.en:
- Money: spent ₹33.1 lakh of ₹29 lakh budget. Should-have-paid to recover: ₹14.6 lakh (30 work orders).
- Act today: 31 open complaints; check 8 misfiled and 34 bounced ones.
- Top road: RD0203 Western Express Highway. Hot mix patch, about ₹14,924.

- पैसे: ₹29 लाख बजेटपैकी ₹33.1 लाख खर्च. वसूल करायचे ₹14.6 लाख (30 वर्क ऑर्डर).

morning.qc2Reason: 'Misfiled' (wrong category) was turned into 'wrongly closed', which implies staff closed cases wrongly; not what the count measures.

corporator.en: Thank you for raising this. In R/C, 31 complaints are open. We have 11 crews. We are checking 30 work orders worth ₹14.6 lakh that may be recoverable. Next repair is RD0203, Western Express Highway. I will share a status update on the open complaints within one week.
